seo.title: Free Interview Prep Resources | Books, Tools & Question Banks | Rupesh Tiwari
seo.description: Curated interview prep resources for FAANG interviews. Free tools, recommended books, LP question banks, system design guides, and resume checklists from an AWS Senior CSM.

hero.title: Interview Prep Resource Hub
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to prepare—curated by an AWS insider
hero.description: I've compiled the best free and paid resources that I recommend to all my coaching clients. These tools, books, and guides will accelerate your preparation whether or not you work with me.

items.title: Interview Prep Vault
items.description: My free collection of templates, checklists, and frameworks. Includes STAR story templates, system design cheat sheets, and LP mapping worksheets.

items.title: FullStackMaster YouTube
items.description: 100+ free videos on system design, behavioral interviews, AWS concepts, and career growth for senior engineers.

items.title: HelloInterview System Design Course
items.description: Excellent free course covering system design fundamentals. Great for building foundational knowledge before coaching.

items.title: Amazon LP Question Bank
items.description: Day One Careers' comprehensive guide with 200+ real Amazon Leadership Principles interview questions organized by LP.

items.title: Excalidraw
items.description: Free whiteboarding tool perfect for system design interviews. Fast, simple, and works great for live diagramming.

items.title: Mermaid Live Editor
items.description: Create sequence diagrams, flowcharts, and architecture diagrams using simple text syntax. Great for documentation.

items.title: SLA/Uptime Calculator
items.description: Calculate availability percentages, downtime allowances, and understand what 99.9% vs 99.99% really means.

items.title: Latency Numbers Every Programmer Should Know
items.description: Essential reference for understanding system latencies—from L1 cache to cross-continent network calls.

items.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
items.author: Martin Kleppmann
items.description: The bible for distributed systems. Covers replication, partitioning, transactions, and stream processing. Essential for L6+ system design.

items.title: System Design Interview (Vol 1 & 2)
items.author: Alex Xu
items.description: Practical, interview-focused examples. Covers 25+ real system design problems with step-by-step solutions. Great for pattern recognition.

items.title: The Staff Engineer's Path
items.author: Tanya Reilly
items.description: Understanding the Staff+ IC track. Covers technical leadership, influence without authority, and navigating organizational dynamics.

items.title: An Elegant Puzzle
items.author: Will Larson
items.description: Systems thinking for engineering management. Covers team sizing, tech debt management, and organizational design. Essential for EM/Director roles.

items.title: Cracking the Coding Interview
items.author: Gayle Laakmann McDowell
items.description: The classic for coding interview prep. 189 programming questions with detailed solutions. Good for refreshing fundamentals.

items.title: Staff Engineer: Leadership Beyond the Management Track
items.author: Will Larson
items.description: Deep dive into Staff+ archetypes: Tech Lead, Architect, Solver, Right Hand. Helps articulate your value at senior IC levels.

items.name: START Method
items.description: Extended STAR format for behavioral interviews. The Takeaway ties your story to the Leadership Principle and shows growth mindset.

items.name: IFRAILT
items.fullName: Intent, Functional, Rates, Architecture, Interfaces, Latency, Security, Trade-offs
items.description: Comprehensive 8-step framework for system design interviews. Ensures you cover all evaluation criteria systematically.

items.name: CAMPERSO
items.fullName: Consumers, Aggregation, Messaging, Processing, Enrichment, Reporting, Storage, Orchestration
items.description: Specialized framework for data engineering and data pipeline system design questions.

criteria.name: Requirements Gathering
criteria.description: Do you ask clarifying questions? Do you define functional and non-functional requirements?

criteria.name: High-Level Design
criteria.description: Is the architecture appropriate? Are components well-chosen? Is data flow clear?

criteria.name: Deep Dive
criteria.description: Can you go deep on 1-2 components? Do you show real expertise, not just surface knowledge?

criteria.name: Trade-offs
criteria.description: Do you articulate trade-offs? Can you explain why you chose X over Y?

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Is your explanation clear? Can you drive the conversation? Do you check in with the interviewer?

criteria.name: Specificity
criteria.description: Are your examples specific and detailed? Vague stories signal weak preparation or exaggeration.

criteria.name: Ownership
criteria.description: Do you clearly articulate YOUR role? Using 'I' appropriately shows individual contribution.

criteria.name: Impact
criteria.description: Are results quantified? Business metrics, not just technical outputs.

criteria.name: Leadership Signals
criteria.description: Do stories demonstrate the Leadership Principle being evaluated? Strategic thinking for senior roles.

criteria.name: Self-Awareness
criteria.description: Do you acknowledge failures and learnings? Growth mindset is essential at senior levels.

cta.title: Ready to Put These Resources to Work?
cta.description: Resources are a starting point. Personalized coaching helps you apply them effectively and get feedback on your specific gaps.
